newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down as 3rd mth falls below 1,280.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down as 3rd mth falls below 1,280.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Jly (3rd pos) 1,270 rgt/tonne May (south) 1,350
Open/Hi/Low 1,282/1,282/1,268 Prev close 1,365
Prev settlement 1,285 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market ended lower, extending overnight losses on bearish sentiment, technical selling, profit-taking and higher near-term output. Soyoil weakness also affected prices, with double-digit losses seen across-the-board. Trading was volatile. July contract is likely to test 1,262 as the chart is starting to show a downward signal.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also turned easier on selling among CPOs.
A technical analayst said the July futures contract will likely fall to strong immediate support at 1,262.
"With soyoil falling overnight and expectation of more losses tonight, we feel that sentiment will continue to remain weak," the trader said.
At the close, the July contract lost 15 ringgit to 1,270 ($506.58) a tonne after trading between 1,268 and 1,282.
The contract hit a high of 1,296 ringgit on Monday but thereafter fell back gradually on lack of follow-through support as the charts were seen turning downwards.
"Sentiment turned bearish as the market was exhausted after July futures was unable to breach the 1,300 level yesterday," the trader added.
"The fundamental outlook particularly an expectation of high output in coming months also put pressure on the market," said another trader.
Malaysian private forecaster Ivan Wong will release his forecast on Wednesday for key April crop data. The report could give the market a lead.
Trading was volatile and turnover was 2,799 lots.

Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,350 vs bids of 1,345 after trading from 1,355 to 1,350. May (central) saw offers at 1,335 vs bids 1,325 with earlier trades done at 1,335 and 1,330.
June (south) was offered at 1,330 vs bids at 1,320 with earlier trades done at 1,335 and 1,330.
June (central) saw offers at 1,315 versus bids at 1,305.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $565, June at $555 and July/Aug/Sept at $547.50. May was traded at $565.
May RBD palm olein saw offers at $602.50, June at $595, July at $585 and July/Aug/Sept at $575. July was traded at $580 and July/Aug/Sept at $572.50.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $432.50 and May/June palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $290.
